footnote_text: Represents a sale pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan entered into by the Reporting Person on August 25, 2025  (the "10b5-1 Plan"). The 10b5-1 Plan is scheduled to terminate on January 3, 2027, and covers the sale of up to an aggregate of 20,784 shares of the Issuer's common stock to help satisfy tax obligations upon the vesting of shares received for service on the Company's board of directors.
